```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls()) # Clear environment
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r packages,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(DescTools) 
library(broom)
library(zoo)
```

```{r read_data,include=FALSE}
working_path='~/Dropbox/data_quickpay/qp_replication/working/'
reg_df_subset=fread(paste0(working_path,
                 'w_clean_control.csv'))
```

```{r merge_with_reg, include=FALSE}
# Create two digit task and naics codes
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_psc:=substr(product_or_service_code,1,3)]
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_naics:=substr(naics_code,1,2)]
# Restrict to competitively awarded projects 
reg_df_subset=reg_df_subset[competitively_awarded_i==1]
```

```{r define_sa, include=FALSE}
reg_df_subset[,quarter_when_project_signed:=as.Date(as.yearqtr(as.Date(initial_start_date)),
                                                       frac = 1)]
reg_df_subset=reg_df_subset[quarter_when_project_signed<=action_date_year_quarter]

reg_df_subset[,project_signed_after_quickpay:=case_when(initial_start_date>=as.Date('2011-04-27') &
                                                   action_date_year_quarter>=as.Date('2011-04-27')~1,
                                                 initial_start_date<as.Date('2011-04-27') ~ 0)]

reg_df_subset=reg_df_subset[order(contract_award_unique_key,
                                  quarter_when_project_signed)]

competition_df=unique(reg_df_subset,
                   by='contract_award_unique_key')
```

```{r did_on_subsamples, include=FALSE}
# Create task-naics ID by concatenating the two
competition_df[,task_naics:=paste(two_digit_psc,
                                 two_digit_naics,
                                 sep="_")]
# Get list of unique task-naics combinations
list_of_task_naics=unique(competition_df$task_naics)
# Create a data table corresponding to each task-naics code
did_list=unique(competition_df[,c('task_naics')])
# Create empty columns
did_list[,duration_did_coef:=NaN]
did_list[,duration_did_se:=NaN]
did_list[,duration_did_nobs:=NaN]

did_list[,budget_did_coef:=NaN]
did_list[,budget_did_se:=NaN]
did_list[,budget_did_nobs:=NaN]

did_list[,offers_did_coef:=NaN]
did_list[,offers_did_se:=NaN]
did_list[,offers_did_nobs:=NaN]
```

```{r run_loop, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
i=1
for(i in 1:length(list_of_task_naics)){
  print(i)
  tryCatch({
  # Create subsample for every task-naics combination
  df=competition_df[task_naics==list_of_task_naics[i]]
  # Regress duration, budget, offers against treat x post with time FE
  m_duration=feols(winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i~treat_new+
                 treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay|quarter_when_project_signed,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=df
      )
  m_budget=feols(winsorized_initial_budget_i~treat_new+
                 treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay|quarter_when_project_signed,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=df
      )
  m_offers=feols(wins_number_of_offers_received~treat_new+
                 treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay|quarter_when_project_signed,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=df
      )
  
  # Save DID coefficients
  duration_summary=setDT(tidy(m_duration))
  duration_did_estimate=duration_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$estimate[[1]]
  duration_did_std_error=duration_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$std.error[[1]]
  did_list[i,duration_did_coef:=duration_did_estimate]
  did_list[i,duration_did_se:=duration_did_std_error]
  did_list[i,duration_did_nobs:=nobs(m_duration)]
  
  budget_summary=setDT(tidy(m_budget))
  budget_did_estimate=budget_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$estimate[[1]]
  budget_did_std_error=budget_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$std.error[[1]]
  did_list[i,budget_did_coef:=budget_did_estimate]
  did_list[i,budget_did_se:=budget_did_std_error]
  did_list[i,budget_did_nobs:=nobs(m_budget)]
  
  offers_summary=setDT(tidy(m_offers))
  offers_did_estimate=offers_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$estimate[[1]]
  offers_did_std_error=offers_summary[term=='treat_new:project_signed_after_quickpay']$std.error[[1]]
  did_list[i,offers_did_coef:=offers_did_estimate]
  did_list[i,offers_did_se:=offers_did_std_error]
  did_list[i,offers_did_nobs:=nobs(m_offers)]
  
  i=i+1}, 
  error=function(e){}) # skip errors
}

```

```{r merge_df, include=FALSE}
# Merge with the data on competitively awarded projects
competition_df=merge(competition_df,
                    did_list,
                    by=c('task_naics'),
                    all.x=T)

# Get "correct" bid metrics; essentially subtract DiD coefficient from actual value
# E.g., if DID coef for duration = -10. It means initial durations are 10 days shorter after QP
# So we want to add this back to the actual duration. 
# Do this only for treated projects that started after QP, keep the pre-QP projects and post-QP control projects as is

competition_df[,correct_durations:=ifelse(initial_start_date>as.Date('2011-04-27') & 
                                          treat_new==1,
                                         winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i-duration_did_coef,
                                         winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)]

competition_df[,correct_budget:=ifelse(initial_start_date>as.Date('2011-04-27') & 
                                            treat_new==1,
                                         winsorized_initial_budget_i-budget_did_coef,
                                      winsorized_initial_budget_i)]

competition_df[,correct_offers:=ifelse(initial_start_date>as.Date('2011-04-27') & 
                                            treat_new==1,
                                      wins_number_of_offers_received-offers_did_coef,
                                      wins_number_of_offers_received)]
```

```{r merge_with_comp, include=FALSE}
competition_df_sub=competition_df[,c('contract_award_unique_key',
                                 'correct_budget',
                                 'correct_durations',
                                 'correct_offers')]

reg_df_subset=merge(reg_df_subset,
                    competition_df_sub,
                    by='contract_award_unique_key',
                    all.x = T)
```

```{r compare_results, include=FALSE}
reg_new_1=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                 treat_new:post_t+
        log(1+correct_durations)+
        correct_offers+
        log(1+correct_budget)+
          log(wins_project_quarter_stage)|
                 action_date_year_quarter,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=reg_df_subset
      )

reg_new_2=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                 treat_new:post_t+
        log(1+correct_durations)+
        correct_offers+
        log(1+correct_budget)+
        post_t:log(1+correct_durations)+
        post_t:correct_offers+
        post_t:log(1+correct_budget)+
          log(wins_project_quarter_stage)|
                 action_date_year_quarter,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=reg_df_subset
      )

reg_new_3=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                 treat_new:post_t+
        log(1+correct_durations)+
        correct_offers+
        log(1+correct_budget)+
        post_t:log(1+correct_durations)+
        post_t:correct_offers+
        post_t:log(1+correct_budget)+
          log(wins_project_quarter_stage)|
                 action_date_year_quarter+
                 product_or_service_code,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=reg_df_subset
      )

reg_new_4=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                 treat_new:post_t+
        log(1+correct_durations)+
        correct_offers+
        log(1+correct_budget)+
        post_t:log(1+correct_durations)+
        post_t:correct_offers+
        post_t:log(1+correct_budget)+
          log(wins_project_quarter_stage)|
                 action_date_year_quarter+
                 product_or_service_code+
                 naics_code,
        cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
        data=reg_df_subset
      )

corrected=list(reg_new_1,reg_new_2,reg_new_3, reg_new_4)
```

```{r output, results='asis'}
setFixest_dict(dict=c("wins_percentage_delay"="Percent delay rate",
                      "post_t"="Post",
                      "treat_new"="Treat",
                      "log(wins_project_quarter_stage)"="Project stage",
                      "log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)"="Initial duration",
                      "log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)"="Initial budget",
                      "wins_number_of_offers_received"="Number of offers",
                      "log(1+correct_durations)"="Corrected duration",
                      "log(1+correct_budget)"="Corrected budget",
                      "correct_offers"="Corrected offers",
                      "contract_award_unique_key"="Project ID",
                      "product_or_service_code"="Task",
                      "action_date_year_quarter"="Time",
                      "naics_code"="Industry",
                      "awarding_sub_agency_code"="Subagency"
                      ))

etable(corrected,
       digits='r2',
       digits.stats = 2,
       fontsize = "small",
       title="Corrected bids: Competitively awarded projects",
       fitstat = c("pr2","n","r2"),
       drop=c("Project stage"),
       style.tex=style.tex(fixef.title = "",
                           fixef.suffix = " FE",
                           var.title = "\\midrule ",
                           depvar.title = "",
                           model.title = "",
                           stats.title = "",
                           model.format = "I",
                           yesNo = c("Yes","No"),
                           line.bottom="simple",
                           line.top="simple"),
       # notes="Controls include Log(project stage), Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids. Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids are also interacted with Post are also included as controls",
       tex=TRUE)
```
